title: Virtual Environments

sections.title: Why Isolation?
sections.markdown: Global package installations can cause dependency conflicts. Environment isolation solves this by keeping dependencies separate for each project.
key_points: Why Isolation? is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Why in real code

sections.title: Creating a venv
sections.markdown: You can create a virtual environment using the built-in `venv` module by running `python -m venv env_name`.
key_points: Creating a venv is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Creating in real code

sections.title: Activating a venv
sections.markdown: Activation changes your shell's PATH to use the virtual environment's Python and pip.
key_points: Activating a venv is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Activating in real code

sections.title: Pip Install
sections.markdown: Once activated, you can use `pip install` to add packages specific to your environment.
key_points: Pip Install is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Pip in real code

sections.title: Requirements.txt
sections.markdown: The `requirements.txt` file (or simply requirements) tracks your exact dependencies for sharing.
key_points: Requirements.txt is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Requirements.txt in real code

sections.title: Reproducibility
sections.markdown: By pinning exact versions in your requirements, you ensure reproducibility across different machines.
key_points: Reproducibility is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Reproducibility in real code

sections.title: Interpreter Selection
sections.markdown: IDEs often require manual interpreter selection to ensure they provide completions based on your virtual environment.
key_points: Interpreter Selection is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interpreter in real code

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.markdown: A standard project structure usually places the venv folder in the root and ignores it in version control.
key_points: Project Structure is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Project in real code

sections.title: Interview Points
sections.markdown: Interviewers might ask how you manage dependencies and handle conflicts using isolated environments.
key_points: Interview Points is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interview in real code

interview_takeaways: Understand how pip and venv interact.
common_mistakes: Committing the venv folder to git.
